opportunities.title: $89M and Climbing: How the Coldcard Attack Drained Wallets Without Ever Touching the Devices
opportunities.why_now: Losses have escalated daily from $38M to $70M to $89M across 4,500 addresses in under a week, with CoinDesk's technical postmortem revealing the attack never compromised the hardware itself.
opportunities.angle: Deep-dive security explainer dissecting the actual attack vector (supply chain/seed generation, not device compromise), contrasting the panic headlines with what security researchers actually found — 'we told you cold storage isn't magic' voice.

opportunities.title: CZ Says 'Diversify Your Wallets' — Translation: Even Crypto's Biggest Custody Advocate Doesn't Trust One Device
opportunities.why_now: CZ publicly reacted to the $70M Coldcard exploit with a 'nothing is 100%' warning, days after CryptoQuant flagged it as the biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX.
opportunities.angle: Sharp opinion piece using CZ's own words against the industry's single-wallet gospel, framed as validation of a security-first, no-single-point-of-failure thesis.

opportunities.title: $676M Through Binance: The Iran Sanctions-Evasion Route On-Chain Forensics Should Have Caught Sooner
opportunities.why_now: Reuters reported an Iran-linked exchange moved $676M through Binance in an alleged sanctions-evasion scheme, surfacing just as regulators scrutinize CEX compliance globally.
opportunities.angle: Security/compliance analysis walking through how the flows likely worked and why on-chain monitoring tools exist precisely to catch this — 'this was always going to happen' framing for CEX AML gaps.

opportunities.title: SummerFi Is Dead: Another DeFi Protocol Killed by an Exploit It Never Recovered From
opportunities.why_now: SummerFi announced its wind-down after seven years, explicitly citing an exploit as the cause — a fresh case study in how hacks quietly end protocols long after headlines fade.
opportunities.angle: Postmortem/obituary format tracing the exploit-to-shutdown timeline, positioned as the latest data point in the 'DeFi security debt always comes due' thesis.

opportunities.title: Solana's New CISO Just Confirmed What Security People Already Feared: AI Scams Are Getting Undetectable
opportunities.why_now: Solana Foundation's newly appointed CISO issued a direct warning this week that AI is making crypto scams significantly more convincing, right as AI-generated fraud tooling proliferates.
opportunities.angle: Commentary tying the CISO's warning to concrete recent scam patterns (deepfake voice, fake support, AI-cloned wallets), framed as an early-warning piece for the next scam wave.
